keyword: what is the 25th amendment to the constitution

verifications.claim: The 25th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was ratified in 1967.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Ratified in 1967'; R4: 'Ratified February 10, 1967'; R5: 'ratified on February 10, 1967'; R3: 'added to the U.S. Constitution in 1967'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state ratification in 1967, some with exact date.

verifications.claim: 25th Amendment Section 1 confirms that if the President dies, resigns, or is removed from office, the Vice President becomes President.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Section 1 ... confirming that the Vice President becomes President when the latter dies, resigns, or is removed'; R4: 'Section 1 In case of the removal of the President from office or of his death or resignation, the Vice President shall become President.'
verifications.reasoning: Exact wording of Section 1 quoted or paraphrased directly in sources.

verifications.claim: 25th Amendment Section 2 authorizes the President to nominate a new Vice President, subject to approval by a majority vote in both houses of Congress.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Section 2 states that ... the president will nominate a vice president who will be confirmed by a majority Congressional vote'; R4: 'Section 2 Whenever there is a vacancy ... confirmation by a majority vote of both Houses of Congress.'

verifications.claim: 25th Amendment Section 3 enables the President to declare in writing that they are unable to perform their duties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Section 3 allows an incapacitated President ... to relinquish his powers ... by sending a written declaration'; R4: 'Section 3 Whenever the President transmits ... his written declaration that he is unable to discharge ...'
verifications.reasoning: Sources quote or describe the written declaration process directly.

verifications.claim: Under 25th Amendment Section 3, the Vice President becomes Acting President until the President declares they are able to return.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Section 3 states that if the president tells ... in writing that he is unable ... the duties shall fall to the vice president as acting president until the president notifies them in writing otherwise'; R2: 'until the President communicates that he is again able ... the Vice President serves as Acting President.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support from Section 3 text and explanations.

verifications.claim: 25th Amendment Section 4 allows the Vice President and a majority of the Cabinet (or a body designated by Congress) to declare the President incapacitated by transmitting a written declaration to Congress.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Section 4 ... the Vice President and a majority of the "principal officers of the executive departments" ... or ... another body that Congress designates ... send a written declaration'; R4: 'Section 4 Whenever the Vice President and a majority of either the principal officers ... transmit ... their written declaration'
verifications.reasoning: Exact process described, including Cabinet or designated body.

verifications.claim: Under 25th Amendment Section 4, the Vice President immediately becomes Acting President.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Section 4 stipulates that when the vice president and a majority ... declare ... the vice president immediately becomes acting president'; R4: 'the Vice President shall immediately assume the powers ... as Acting President.'

verifications.claim: Under 25th Amendment Section 4, if the president declares that no inability exists, they can resume their powers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The president can then submit a written declaration to the contrary and resume presidential powers'; R2: 'If the President subsequently declares ... that he is again able ... he "shall resume the powers and duties of his office"'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm resumption upon president's declaration (unless contested, but claim accurate as stated).

verifications.claim: Under 25th Amendment Section 4, if the Vice President and a majority of the Cabinet contest this within four days, Congress must decide the issue.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'unless the vice president and a majority body of Congress declare in writing within four days ... Congress will vote on the issue'; R3: 'unless, within four days, the vice president and a majority ... double down ... Then, if Congress ... agrees'
verifications.reasoning: Precise timeline and process for contestation leading to Congress decision.

verifications.claim: Under 25th Amendment Section 4, Congress requires a two-thirds vote in both houses to sustain the removal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'if Congress, by a two-thirds vote in both the House and Senate, agrees'; R4: 'determines by two-thirds vote of both Houses that the President is unable ... the Vice President shall continue ... as Acting President'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify two-thirds vote in both houses to sustain VP as Acting President.
